question: In the year 2022, at what altitude was the Earth Observation Satellite (EOS-04) placed into a sun-synchronous polar orbit?
solution: The correct answer is__** 529 km.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • An **Earth observation satellite (EOS)** is a type of satellite specifically designed to monitor and collect data about the Earth’s surface and atmosphere. • These satellites play a crucial role in various applications, including environmental monitoring, meteorology, cartography, and disaster management. • EOS-04 also known as** RISAT-1A**; it is an Earth Observation Satellite launched by ISRO. • The satellite was placed at an **altitude of 529 km **to achieve this orbit. • **A Sun-synchronous orbit** keeps a satellite at the same local solar time over a specific part of the Earth. • EOS-04 was launched on February 14, 2022, from the **Satish Dhawan Space Centre**.
